finalText.descriptionEn: The learner can apply the Nernst equation to galvanic cells, especially concentration cells, calculate cell voltages under non-standard conditions, and justify statements about cell voltage.

Profile recommendation: revise. Its current 04-b transfer insists on two dissolved redox forms and goes beyond the explicit BB/BE metal/metal-ion restriction; the source-bound NW inverse concentration-from-voltage operator is also not exercised by either complete case.  Scope: sealed D-FIRST and actual final native-v2 PDF/HTML/model, 32 complete bilingual cases, 16 profile bodies, finite whole source-cell/partner/passages; no whole-national mapping or effective projection approval.
A essentialUnderstanding: Zur selben formulierten Zellreaktion gehören das stöchiometrische Q, die Elektronenzahl n und die reversible Spannung; offene und belastete Zelle sind zu unterscheiden.
